assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production raster background for a side-scrolling browser running game, one seamless horizontal environment plate, 3072 x 1024 landscape (3:1).
Input image 1 is ONLY the approved runner STYLE reference. Do not draw the runner or any people in this background.
Primary request: a quiet waterfront neighborhood street with a modest red-and-cream corner diner, two low shop fronts, a distant small harbor bridge and broad open pavement. Match the reference's clean confident black contours, simple rounded geometry and broad flat cel colors. Soft muted blue sky, warm cream facades, dusty brick red, pale turquoise window panes. Daylight. Background contrast and detail should be quieter than the reference character.
Composition: strictly side-on, flat horizontal street, no vanishing-point road. Sky occupies the upper 22 percent, small background bridge and the low buildings the middle from 22 to 67 percent. Building bases share one perfectly horizontal curb at exactly 67 percent of the image height. The entire bottom 33 percent is empty calm cool-gray asphalt, with only a few widely spaced thin horizontal seams near the very bottom. No foreground objects. Diner only one modest building among several, not a focal-point closeup. Left and right edges terminate in the same pale cream low wall and gray pavement for repeating the image without mirroring.
Style constraints: simple television-animation background; black outlines, flat paint, at most one flat shadow tone per surface. No painterly texture, no gradients, no glow, no wet reflections, no dramatic lighting, no tiny detail, no giant moon. No text, lettering, logos, UI, cars, people, obstacles or collectible objects. Return only the full-bleed environment raster.
